demo.program:
# V — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created V?", "Alexander Medvednikov"),
    ("What paradigm is V?", "multi-paradigm"),
    ("What is creator?", "Alexander Medvednikov"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "2019"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "multi-paradigm"),
    ("What is typing?", "static"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".v"),
    ("What is hello world?", "println(\"Hello, world!\")"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
